physical_source: Fraser and Massom 2020 fast-ice v2.2 doi:10.26179/5d267d1ceb60c

frozen_site.source: LaRue et al 2024 author-published rounded colony centroid, not actual nest polygon

georeferencing.selection: nearest projected x/y point with minimum independently stored latitude/longitude geodesic error to published colony centroid, provided residual ≤3km. DO NOT select based on observed fast-ice class.
georeferencing.north_south_and_axis_validation: Always verify actual 2D latitude/longitude at coordinate before any ice cell reading; project definitions are candidate metadata not proof.

time_selection.preobservation_rule: last composite date not after original image; next composite sensitivity requires separate contract

prohibited: social attraction conclusion from guano non-detection
